## Diagramme 1 : User / Member / Librarian
```{mermaid}
classDiagram
class User {
    +id: int
    +username: String
    +email: String
    +password: String
    +role: Role
}
%% Base class for all users

class Member {
    +encryptionKey: String
    +borrowHistory(): List<BorrowRecord>
    +submitWork()
    +borrowWork()
}
%% Registered user who can submit and borrow works

class Librarian {
    +moderationRights: bool
    +moderateWork()
    +enrichMetadata()
    +validateWork()
}
%% Member with additional privileges

User <|-- Member
Member <|-- Librarian
